entries.zh: 评论家认为这出戏技术上精致，却不感人。

entries.en: The protective film was only one mil thick.
entries.zh: 这层保护膜只有一密耳厚。

entries.en: A tatter of blue cloth fluttered from the broken fence.
entries.zh: 一条蓝色破布在破篱笆上飘动。

entries.en: She tried not to monopolise the discussion with her own stories.
entries.zh: 她尽量不让自己的故事独占整场讨论。

entries.en: The museum marked the issuance of the first local postage stamp.
entries.zh: 博物馆纪念了第一枚本地邮票的发行。

entries.en: The novel imagines an interplanetary journey aboard a tiny research ship.
entries.zh: 这部小说想象了一次乘坐小型科考飞船进行的行星间旅行。

entries.en: The anatomy chart highlighted the carotid arteries in red.
entries.zh: 解剖图用红色突出标示了颈动脉。

entries.en: She considered helping her elderly neighbour a mitzvah.
entries.zh: 她把帮助年迈的邻居视为履行宗教义务的善行。

entries.en: The shepherd pointed towards yon hill beyond the river.
entries.zh: 牧羊人指向河那边的那座山。

entries.en: A tiny wormhole pierced the cover of the old wooden box.
entries.zh: 一个小蛀孔穿透了旧木盒的盖子。

entries.en: The reading club welcomed every preteen in the neighbourhood.
entries.zh: 这个读书俱乐部欢迎社区里所有青春期前的孩子参加。

entries.en: The neuroscientist showed students images from her memory experiment.
entries.zh: 神经科学家向学生展示了她的记忆实验中的图像。

entries.en: A narrow slit produced a clear diffraction pattern on the screen.
entries.zh: 一道窄缝在屏幕上产生了清晰的衍射图样。

entries.en: The chemistry experiment measured the heat released during hydration.
entries.zh: 这项化学实验测量了水合过程中释放的热量。

entries.en: The thrower stepped forward and released the discus.
entries.zh: 投掷者向前迈步，掷出了铁饼。

entries.en: The reintroduction of wolves changed the reserve's wildlife management plan.
entries.zh: 重新引入狼改变了保护区的野生动物管理计划。

entries.en: The new factory brought a threefold increase in local production.
entries.zh: 新工厂使当地的产量增至原来的三倍。

entries.en: She travelled unencumbered by luggage, carrying only a small shoulder bag.
entries.zh: 她没有行李负担地出行，只带了一个小挎包。

entries.en: The archeologist brushed soil from the edge of the ancient bowl.
entries.zh: 考古学家从古碗边缘刷去了泥土。

entries.en: There was much ado before the unexpected visitors arrived.
entries.zh: 意外来客到达前，大家忙乱了一阵。
